items.title: Sri Suktam (Hiranyavarnam Harinim): The 16 Rigvedic Mantras of Goddess Mahalakshmi
items.author: Rishi Ananda, Kardama & Chiklita (Rigveda Khila)
items.description: Read the complete Sri Suktam (Hiranyavarnam Harinim Suvarnarajatasrajam) from the Rigveda Khilani — the supreme Vedic hymn invoking Goddess Sri Mahalakshmi for spiritual and material abundance.

body.English:
Found in the Khilani (appendices) of the Fifth Mandala of the Rigveda, the Sri Suktam (15/16 main Richas plus Phalashruti) is the oldest and most authoritative Vedic hymn addressed to Goddess Sri (Mahalakshmi), invoking the Sacred Fire (Jataveda Agni) to bring pure auspiciousness, wisdom, nourishment, and freedom from Alakshmi (poverty, laziness, and discord).

Key Rigvedic Richas & Meaning:
1. "Om Hiranyavarnam harinim suvarnarajatasrajam |
    Chandram hiranmayim Lakshmim Jatavedo ma avaha || 1 ||"
   (O Omniscient Agni Jataveda! Invoke for me Goddess Lakshmi, who shines with a golden hue, who removes all sins and sorrows, who is adorned with garlands of gold and silver, and who is cooling and radiant like the full moon!)
2. "Tam ma avaha Jatavedo Lakshmim anapagaminim |
    Yasyam hiranyam vindeyam gam ashvam purushan aham || 2 ||"
   (O Jataveda! Invoke for me that unfailing, ever-abiding Lakshmi, blessed by whom I shall attain spiritual and righteous wealth, cattle, vigour, and noble companions!)
3. "Kshutpipasamalam jyeshtham Alakshmir nashayamyaham |
    Abhutim asavriddhim cha sarvan nirnuda me grihat || 8 ||"
   (By Her grace I banish hunger, thirst, impurity, and Alakshmi; O Mother, drive away all scarcity and stagnation from my home and heart!)
body.Hindi:
ऋग्वेद के खिल-सूक्त के अंतर्गत १६ ऋचाओं वाला 'श्रीसूक्तम्' भगवती महालक्ष्मी की आराधना का प्राचीनतम और सर्वोच्च वैदिक मन्त्र-स्तव है। दीपावली, शुक्रवार और नित्य पूजा में इसके पाठ से दरिद्रता और अलक्ष्मी का नाश होकर स्थायी श्री, विद्या और सौभाग्य की प्राप्ति होती है।

॥ श्रीसूक्तम् (प्रमुख वैदिक ऋचाएँ एवं भावार्थ) ॥
ॐ हिरण्यवर्णां हरिणीं सुवर्णरजतस्रजाम् । चन्द्रां हिरण्मयीं लक्ष्मीं जातवेदो म आवह ॥ १ ॥
तां म आवह जातवेदो लक्ष्मीमनपगामिनीम् । यस्यां हिरण्यं विन्देयं गामश्वं पुरुषानहम् ॥ २ ॥
अश्वपूर्वां रथमध्यां हस्तिनादप्रबोधिनीम् । श्रियं देवीमुपह्वये श्रीर्मा देवी जुषताम् ॥ ३ ॥
कांसोस्मितां हिरण्यप्राकारामार्द्रां ज्वलन्तीं तृप्तां तर्पयन्तीम् । पद्मे स्थितां पद्मवर्णां तामिहोपह्वये श्रियम् ॥ ४ ॥
चन्द्रां प्रभासां यशसा ज्वलन्तीं श्रियं लोके देवजुष्टामुदाराम् । तां पद्मिनीमीं शरणमहं प्रपद्येऽलक्ष्मीर्मे नश्यतां त्वां वृणे ॥ ५ ॥
body.Sanskrit:
ॐ हिरण्यवर्णां हरिणीं सुवर्णरजतस्रजाम् ।
चन्द्रां हिरण्मयीं लक्ष्मीं जातवेदो म आवह ॥ १ ॥
तां म आवह जातवेदो लक्ष्मीमनपगामिनीम् ।
यस्यां हिरण्यं विन्देयं गामश्वं पुरुषानहम् ॥ २ ॥
अश्वपूर्वां रथमध्यां हस्तिनादप्रबोधिनीम् ।
श्रियं देवीमुपह्वये श्रीर्मा देवी जुषताम् ॥ ३ ॥

items.title: Isha Upanishad (Ishavasyam Idam Sarvam): Complete 18 Mantras & Meaning
items.author: Shukla Yajurveda (Kanva & Madhyandina Shakha)

body.English:
Standing first among all Upanishads and embedded directly as the 40th chapter of the Vajasaneyi Samhita of the Shukla Yajurveda, the Isha Upanishad (18 Mantras) bridges sacred action in the world with non-dual realization of the Supreme Self.

Shanti Mantra & Key Mantras:
• Shanti Mantra:
  "Om Purnamadah Purnamidam Purnat Purnamudachyate |
   Purnasya Purnamadaya Purnamevavashishyate ||"
  (That transcendent Brahman is Full/Infinite; this visible universe is also Full. From the Infinite alone does the Infinite come forth; even when the Infinite is drawn from the Infinite, the Infinite alone remains!)

• Mantra 1 (The Golden Key of Renunciation in Enjoyment):
  "Ishavasyam idam sarvam yat kincha jagatyam jagat |
   Tena tyaktena bhunjitha ma gridhah कस्यस्विद्धनम् (kasyasvid dhanam) || 1 ||"
  (Everything moving and unmoving in this entire cosmos is indwelt and enveloped by the Supreme Lord [Isha]. Therefore, nourish yourself through detachment and grateful sharing; covet not anyone's wealth!)

• Mantras 6–7 (Unity of All Beings — Overcoming Delusion & Grief):
  "Yastu sarvani bhutani atmanyevanupashyati |
   Sarvabhuteshu chatmanam tato na vijugupsate || 6 ||
   Yasmin sarvani bhutani atmaivabhud vijanatah |
   Tatra ko mohah kah shokah ekatvam anupashyatah || 7 ||"
  (Whoever beholds all beings within the Self, and the Self within all beings, never turns away in hatred from anyone. For the sage who perceives this oneness everywhere, what delusion or sorrow can ever remain?)

• Mantra 15 (Prayer to Unveil the Golden Disc of Truth):
  "Hiranmayena patrena satyasyapihitam mukham |
   Tat tvam Pushann apavrinu satya-dharmaya drishtaye || 15 ||"
  (The face of Ultimate Truth is veiled by a dazzling golden disc; O Nourishing Sun [Pushan], unveil it so that I, devoted to Truth-Dharma, may behold the Imperishable Reality!)
body.Hindi:
शुक्ल यजुर्वेद की वाजसनेयी संहिता का ४०वाँ अध्याय 'ईशावास्योपनिषद्' (१८ मन्त्र) दसोपनिषदों में प्रथम स्थान रखता है। महात्मा गाँधी ने इसके प्रथम मन्त्र को सम्पूर्ण हिन्दू धर्म का सार कहा था।

॥ शान्तिपाठ एवं प्रमुख मन्त्र ॥
ॐ पूर्णमदः पूर्णमिदं पूर्णात्पूर्णमुदच्यते । पूर्णस्य पूर्णमादाय पूर्णमेवावशिष्यते ॥

ईशावास्यमिदँ सर्वं यत्किञ्च जगत्यां जगत् । तेन त्यक्तेन भुञ्जीथा मा गृधः कस्यस्विद्धनम् ॥ १ ॥
भावार्थ: इस गतिशील ब्रह्माण्ड में जो कुछ भी जड़-चेतन जगत है, वह सब ईश्वर से व्याप्त है। अतः त्यागभाव (अनासक्ति) से इसका भोग और रक्षण करो; किसी के धन का लोभ मत करो।

यस्तु सर्वाणि भूतान्यात्मन्येवानुपश्यति । सर्वभूतेषु चात्मानं ततो न विजुगुप्सते ॥ ६ ॥
यस्मिन्सर्वाणि भूतान्यात्मैवाभूद्विजानतः । तत्र को मोहः कः शोक एकत्वमनुपश्यतः ॥ ७ ॥
भावार्थ: जो साधक सम्पूर्ण प्राणियों को अपने आत्मा में ही देखता है और समस्त प्राणियों में अपनी आत्मा को देखता है, वह किसी से घृणा नहीं करता। सर्वत्र एकत्व देखने वाले उस ज्ञानी के लिए फिर कौन-सा मोह और कौन-सा शोक रह सकता है!

हिरण्मयेन पात्रेण सत्यस्यापिहितं मुखम् । तत्त्वं पूषन्नपावृणु सत्यधर्माय दृष्टये ॥ १५ ॥
body.Sanskrit:
ॐ पूर्णमदः पूर्णमिदं पूर्णात्पूर्णमुदच्यते ।
पूर्णस्य पूर्णमादाय पूर्णमेवावशिष्यते ॥

ईशावास्यमिदँ सर्वं यत्किञ्च जगत्यां जगत् ।
तेन त्यक्तेन भुञ्जीथा मा गृधः कस्यस्विद्धनम् ॥ १ ॥
कुर्वन्नेवेह कर्माणि जिजीविषेच्छतँ समाः ।
एवं त्वयि नान्यथेतोऽस्ति न कर्म लिप्यते नरे ॥ २ ॥

items.title: Bhagavad Gita Chapter 12 (Bhakti Yoga): All 20 Shlokas on the Devotee Dear to God
items.author: Maharshi Vedavyasa (Spoken by Bhagavan Sri Krishna)

body.English:
In the Twelfth Chapter of the Bhagavad Gita (Bhakti Yoga — 20 Verses), Arjuna asks whether those who worship the personal Lord with loving devotion or those who meditate upon the unmanifest Imperishable Brahman are superior in Yoga. Bhagavan Sri Krishna answers that while both reach Him, the path of loving devotion is the most natural and swift—and in Verses 13–20 (the Amrita-Ashtakam or Eight Nectar Verses), He describes the character of the devotee who is supremely dear to Him:

Key Verses (12.13–15):
• "Adveshta sarva-bhutanam maitrah karuna eva cha |
   Nirmamo nirahankarah sama-duhkha-sukhah kshami || 13 ||
   Santushtah satatam yogi yatatma dridha-nishchayah |
   Mayyarpita-mano-buddhir yo mad-bhaktah sa me priyah || 14 ||"
  Meaning: One who bears no ill-will toward any living being, who is friendly and compassionate to all, free from possessiveness ('mine-ness') and egoism, balanced in pain and pleasure, ever-forgiving, ever-contented, self-controlled, firm in conviction, and whose mind and intellect are offered unto Me—such a devotee is exceedingly dear to Me!
• "Yasmanno dvijate loko lokanno dvijate cha yah |
   Harshamarsha-bhayodvegair mukto yah sa cha me priyah || 15 ||"
  Meaning: One by whom the world is never agitated and who is never agitated by the world, freed from elation, envy, fear, and anxiety—that person is dear to Me!
body.Hindi:
श्रीमद्भगवद्गीता के बारहवें अध्याय ('भक्तियोग' — २० श्लोक) के अंतिम ८ श्लोकों (१२.१३–२०) को भगवान श्रीकृष्ण ने 'धर्म्यामृतम्' (धर्ममय अमृत) कहा है, जिनमें भगवान के परम प्रिय भक्त के ३५ दिव्य लक्षण बताए गए हैं:

अद्वेष्टा सर्वभूतानां मैत्रः करुण एव च । निर्ममो निरहंकारः समदुःखसुखः क्षमी ॥ १३ ॥
सन्तुष्टः सततं योगी यतात्मा दृढनिश्चयः । मय्यर्पितमनोबुद्धिर्यो मद्भक्तः स मे प्रियः ॥ १४ ॥
यस्मान्नोद्विजते लोको लोकान्नोद्विजते च यः । हर्षामर्षभयोद्वेगैर्मुक्तो यः स च मे प्रियः ॥ १५ ॥
भावार्थ: जो किसी भी प्राणी से द्वेष नहीं करता, सबका मित्र और करुणावान है, ममता और अहंकार से रहित है, सुख-दुःख में सम और क्षमाशील है, निरंतर संतुष्ट रहता है तथा जिसका मन और बुद्धि मुझमें अर्पित है—वह भक्त मुझे अत्यंत प्रिय है!
body.Sanskrit:
अद्वेष्टा सर्वभूतानां मैत्रः करुण एव च ।
निर्ममो निरहङ्कारः समदुःखसुखः क्षमी ॥ १२.१३ ॥
सन्तुष्टः सततं योगी यतात्मा दृढनिश्चयः ।
मय्यर्पितमनोबुद्धिर्यो मद्भक्तः स मे प्रियः ॥ १२.१४ ॥
यस्मान्नोद्विजते लोको लोकान्नोद्विजते च यः ।
हर्षामर्षभयोद्वेगैर्मुक्तो यः स च मे प्रियः ॥ १२.१५ ॥

items.title: Sri Rama Raksha Stotram: Rishi Budhakoushika Armour of Protection
items.author: Rishi Budhakoushika
items.description: Read the auspicious Sri Rama Raksha Stotram revealed by Lord Shiva in a dream to Sage Budhakoushika — the protective spiritual armour (Kavacha) of Lord Sri Rama.

body.English:
Revealed by Lord Sadashiva in a night vision to Maharshi Budhakoushika and written down at dawn, the Sri Rama Raksha Stotram (38 verses) serves as an impenetrable spiritual shield (Vajra-Panjara Kavacha) protecting every limb of the body and mind through the holy names of Lord Sri Rama.

Key Shlokas & Meaning:
1. "Charitam Raghunathasya shatakoti-pravistaram |
    Ekaikam aksharam pumsam mahapataka-nashanam || 1 ||"
   (The sacred life-chronicle of Lord Raghunatha spans a hundred crore verses; every single syllable of it destroys the greatest sins of humanity!)
2. "Ramaya Ramabhadraya Ramachandraya Vedhase |
    Raghunathaya Nathaya Sitayah pataye namah || 29 ||"
3. "Manojavam marutatulyavegam jitendriyam buddhimatam varishtham |
    Vatatmajam vanarayuthamukhyam Shriramadutam sharanam prapadye || 33 ||"
   (I take refuge in Sri Hanuman, the messenger of Lord Rama, who is swift as the mind and the wind, master of the senses, foremost among the wise, son of Vayu, and leader of the Vanara hosts!)
body.Hindi:
भगवान सदाशिव द्वारा स्वप्न में महर्षि बुधकौशिक को उपदिष्ट 'श्रीरामरक्षास्तोत्रम्' अमोघ आध्यात्मिक सुरक्षा-कवच ('वज्रपंजर') है:

चरितं रघुनाथस्य शतकोटिप्रविस्तरम् । एकैकमक्षरं पुंसां महापातकनाशनम् ॥ १ ॥
रामाय रामभद्राय रामचन्द्राय वेधसे । रघुनाथाय नाथाय सीतायाः पतये नमः ॥ २९ ॥
मनोजवं मारुततुल्यवेगं जितेन्द्रियं बुद्धिमतां वरिष्ठम् । वातात्मजं वानरयूथमुख्यं श्रीरामदूतं शरणं प्रपद्ये ॥ ३३ ॥
रामेति रामभद्रेति रामचन्द्रेति वा स्मरन् । नरो न लिप्यते पापैर्भुक्तिं मुक्तिं च विन्दति ॥ ३८ ॥
body.Sanskrit:
चरितं रघुनाथस्य शतकोटिप्रविस्तरम् ।
एकैकमक्षरं पुंसां महापातकनाशनम् ॥ १ ॥
रामाय रामभद्राय रामचन्द्राय वेधसे ।
रघुनाथाय नाथाय सीतायाः पतये नमः ॥ २९ ॥
मनोजवं मारुततुल्यवेगं जितेन्द्रियं बुद्धिमतां वरिष्ठम् ।
वातात्मजं वानरयूथमुख्यं श्रीरामदूतं शरणं प्रपद्ये ॥ ३३ ॥

items.title: Madhurashtakam (Adharam Madhuram) & Bhishma Stuti: The Sweetness of Sri Krishna
items.author: Mahaprabhu Sri Vallabhacharya

body.English:
Composed by Mahaprabhu Sri Vallabhacharya (1479–1531 CE), founder of the Pushtimarga (Shuddhadvaita) tradition, the Madhurashtakam (8 verses) celebrates how everything associated with Bhagavan Sri Krishna—the Lord of Sweetness (Madhuradhipati)—is supremely sweet and auspicious:

Complete Verses 1–3:
1. "Adharam madhuram vadanam madhuram, Nayanam madhuram hasitam madhuram |
    Hridayam madhuram gamanam madhuram, Madhuradhipater akhilam madhuram || 1 ||"
   (His lips are sweet, His face is sweet, His eyes are sweet, His smile is sweet; His compassionate heart is sweet, His gait is sweet—everything about the Lord of Sweetness is altogether sweet!)
2. "Vachanam madhuram charitam madhuram, Vasanam madhuram valitam madhuram |
    Chalitam madhuram bhramitam madhuram, Madhuradhipater akhilam madhuram || 2 ||"
3. "Venur madhuro renur madhurah, Panir madhurah padau madhurau |
    Nrityam madhuram sakhyam madhuram, Madhuradhipater akhilam madhuram || 3 ||"
   (His flute is sweet, the dust of His lotus feet is sweet, His hands and feet are sweet, His dance and friendship are sweet—everything about the Lord of Sweetness is altogether sweet!)
body.Hindi:
महाप्रभु श्री वल्लभाचार्य विरचित 'मधुराष्टकम्' भगवान श्रीकृष्ण के मधुर स्वरूप का अमर गान है:

अधरं मधुरं वदनं मधुरं नयनं मधुरं हसितं मधुरम् ।
हृदयं मधुरं गमनं मधुरं मधुराधिपतेरखिलं मधुरम् ॥ १ ॥
वचनं मधुरं चरितं मधुरं वसनं मधुरं वलितं मधुरम् ।
चलितं मधुरं भ्रमितं मधुरं मधुराधिपतेरखिलं मधुरम् ॥ २ ॥
वेणुर्मधुरो रेणुर्मधुरः पाणिर्मधुरः पादौ मधुरौ ।
नृत्यं मधुरं सख्यं मधुरं मधुराधिपतेरखिलं मधुरम् ॥ ३ ॥
गीतं मधुरं पीतं मधुरं भुक्तं मधुरं सुप्तं मधुरम् ।
रूपं मधुरं तिलकं मधुरं मधुराधिपतेरखिलं मधुरम् ॥ ४ ॥
body.Sanskrit:
अधरं मधुरं वदनं मधुरं नयनं मधुरं हसितं मधुरम् ।
हृदयं मधुरं गमनं मधुरं मधुराधिपतेरखिलं मधुरम् ॥ १ ॥
वेणुर्मधुरो रेणुर्मधुरः पाणिर्मधुरः पादौ मधुरौ ।
नृत्यं मधुरं सख्यं मधुरं मधुराधिपतेरखिलं मधुरम् ॥ ३ ॥

items.title: Sri Vishnu Sahasranama & Vidura Niti: The Immortal Wisdom of the Mahabharata
items.author: Maharshi Vedavyasa (Bhishma Pitamaha & Mahatma Vidura)
items.description: Explore the Sri Vishnu Sahasranama Stotram taught by Bhishma Pitamaha to Yudhishthira in the Anushasana Parva of the Mahabharata, along with the ethical statecraft of Vidura Niti.

body.English:
In the Anushasana Parva (Chapter 149) of the Mahabharata, Grandsire Bhishma reveals the 1,000 Sacred Names of Lord Vishnu (Sri Vishnu Sahasranama Stotram) to Yudhishthira in the presence of Bhagavan Sri Krishna:
"Shantakaram Bhujagashayanam Padmanabham Suresham, Vishvadharam Gaganasadrisham Meghavarnam Shubhangam |
Lakshmikantam Kamalanayanam Yogibhir-dhyanagamyam, Vande Vishnum Bhavabhayaharam Sarvalokaikanatham ||"
body.Hindi:

लक्ष्मीकान्तं कमलनयनं योगिभिर्ध्यानगम्यं वन्दे विष्णुं भवभयहरं सर्वलोकैकनाथम् ॥

items.title: Devi Mahatmyam (Durga Saptashati): Argala Stotram & Ya Devi Sarvabhuteshu
items.author: Maharshi Markandeya (Markandeya Mahapurana)

body.English:
Embedded within Chapters 81–93 of the Markandeya Purana, the Devi Mahatmyam (also known as Sri Durga Saptashati or Chandi Patha, consisting of 700 mantras across 13 chapters and 3 Charitas: Mahakali, Mahalakshmi, and Mahasaraswati) is the central scripture of Shakta Dharma.

1. Argala Stotram Prayer:
"Jayanti Mangala Kali Bhadrakali Kapalini |
 Durga Kshama Shiva Dhatri Swaha Swadha namo'stu te ||
 Dehi saubhagyam arogyam dehi me paramam sukham |
 Rupam dehi jayam dehi yasho dehi dvisho jahi ||"
(Grant me auspiciousness, health, and supreme bliss; grant me spiritual radiance, grant me victory, grant me noble renown, and vanquish my inner enemies of lust, anger, and greed!)

2. Tantrokta Devi Suktam (Chapter 5 — Aparajita Stuti):
"Ya Devi sarvabhuteshu Shakti-rupena samsthita | Namastasyai namastasyai namastasyai namo namah ||
 Ya Devi sarvabhuteshu Matri-rupena samsthita | Namastasyai namastasyai namastasyai namo namah ||
 Ya Devi sarvabhuteshu Buddhi-rupena samsthita | Namastasyai namastasyai namastasyai namo namah ||
 Ya Devi sarvabhuteshu Shanti-rupena samsthita | Namastasyai namastasyai namastasyai namo namah ||"

१. अर्गला स्तोत्रम् का प्रसिद्ध प्रार्थना-मन्त्र:
जयन्ती मङ्गला काली भद्रकाली कपालिनी । दुर्गा क्षमा शिवा धात्री स्वाहा स्वधा नमोऽस्तु ते ॥

या देवी सर्वभूतेषु चेतनेत्यभिधीयते । नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः ॥

items.title: Sant Teachings: The Bhakti Movement and the Path of Divine Love
items.description: Explore the rich Sant Parampara of Sanatan Dharma. Discover the Bhakti movement, the poetry of divine love, and the core teachings of mystics like Kabir, Tulsidas, Mirabai, Surdas, and Tukaram.
items.author: Bhaktamal & Sant Vani Sangraha

body.English:
## Overview: The Bhakti Movement & Sant Parampara
Spanning over a millennium from the 6th century CE in South India to the 17th century across North, East, and West India, the Bhakti Movement carried eternal Vedic and Upanishadic realization out of monastic retreats directly into the hearts and daily languages of every householder. Beginning with the Tamil **Alvars** (Vaishnava poet-saints) and **Nayanars** (Shaiva poet-saints), the sacred river of devotion spread across Bharat through great acharyas and mystics.

## Two Great Streams: Saguna & Nirguna Bhakti
1. **Saguna Bhakti (Devotion to the Divine with Form & Attributes):**
   - **Goswami Tulsidas (1532–1623):** Composed the immortal *Shri Ramcharitmanas*, *Hanuman Chalisa*, and *Vinaya Patrika* in Awadhi, making Lord Rama's dharma accessible to every village.
   - **Mahakavi Surdas:** Blind mystic poet of Braj whose *Sur Sagar* celebrates Bala Krishna's divine leelas.
   - **Sant Mirabai:** Princess of Mewar who renounced royal privilege in ecstatic devotion to Giridhar Gopal (Sri Krishna).
   - **Sri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu & Sant Tukaram:** Spread congregational Harinaam Sankirtan across Bengal, Odisha (Puri), and Maharashtra (Varkari tradition of Pandharpur).
2. **Nirguna Bhakti (Devotion to the Formless, Indwelling Absolute):**
   - **Sant Kabir Das:** Weaver-saint of Kashi who emphasized inner purity, Satguru grace, and unity beyond hollow ritualism.
   - **Guru Ravidas, Sant Namdev & Sant Dadu Dayal:** Taught humility, honest livelihood, compassion, and constant remembrance of Hari Naam.

## Core Universal Teachings of the Sants
- **Power of Naam-Smarana:** In Kali Yuga, sincere chanting of the Divine Name (Naam Jaap) is the simplest and surest path to inner peace and liberation.
- **Equality & Compassion:** Every living being houses the same indwelling Paramatma; true devotion dissolves arrogance, greed, and discrimination.
- **Satsanga (Company of Truth):** Associating with truthful, compassionate seekers transforms character effortlessly.
body.Hindi:
## परिचय: भक्ति आन्दोलन एवं भारत की सन्त परम्परा
दक्षिण भारत के आलवार और नयनार संतों से प्रारंभ होकर संपूर्ण भारतवर्ष में प्रवाहित होने वाले भक्ति आन्दोलन ने वेदों और उपनिषदों के गूढ़ ज्ञान को जन-जन की लोकभाषा में सुलभ कर दिया।

## सगुण और निर्गुण भक्ति धाराएँ
1. **सगुण भक्ति धारा:**
   - **गोस्वामी तुलसीदास:** श्रीरामचरितमानस और श्री हनुमान चालीसा द्वारा मर्यादा पुरुषोत्तम श्रीराम की भक्ति को घर-घर पहुँचाया।
   - **सूरदास, मीराबाई, चैतन्य महाप्रभु एवं संत तुकाराम:** श्रीकृष्ण प्रेम, नाम-संकीर्तन और समर्पण का अमर संगीत प्रवाहित किया।
2. **निर्गुण भक्ति धारा:**
   - **संत कबीरदास, संत रविदास, संत नामदेव एवं दादू दयाल:** बाह्याडंबर से परे हृदय की शुद्धता, सद्गुरु कृपा, समता और अंतरस्थ परमात्मा के स्मरण का मार्ग दिखाया।

## संत वाणी के प्रमुख संदेश
- कलियुग में भगवन्नाम का जप (नाम-स्मरण) ही सबसे सरल और अमोघ साधन है।
- सच्ची भक्ति अहंकार को मिटाकर करुणा, सेवा और समभाव को जागृत करती है।

कथयन्तश्च मां नित्यं तुष्यन्ति च रमन्ति च ॥ (भगवद्गीता १०.९)

faqs.q: What is the difference between Saguna and Nirguna Bhakti?
faqs.a: Saguna Bhakti worships the Divine with sacred form and attributes (such as Sri Rama, Sri Krishna, or Maa Durga), whereas Nirguna Bhakti meditates on the formless, all-pervading Absolute.

faqs.q: Why do Bhakti saints emphasize Naam Jaap?
faqs.a: Saints across traditions teach that in Kali Yuga, steady remembrance and chanting of the Divine Name purifies the mind faster and more gently than severe austerities.

items.title: Hindu Philosophy: The Six Orthodox Schools (Shad Darshana)
items.description: Explore the deep philosophical roots of Sanatan Dharma. Discover the Shad Darshana (the six orthodox Astika systems of Indian philosophy): Samkhya, Yoga, Nyaya, Vaisheshika, Mimamsa, and Vedanta.
items.author: Sarva-Darshana-Sangraha & Sutra Texts

body.English:
## Overview: What is Darshana?
In Sanatan Dharma, philosophy is not mere intellectual speculation—it is called **Darshana** ("direct vision or experiential realization of Truth"). The six classical orthodox (*Astika*) systems accept the epistemic authority of the Vedas and are arranged in three complementary philosophical pairs.

## The Six Orthodox Schools (Shad Darshana)
1. **Samkhya (Founder: Maharshi Kapila):** Dualistic enumerative cosmology analyzing reality into two eternal principles—*Purusha* (pure Witness Consciousness) and *Prakriti* (primordial Nature composed of the three Gunas: Sattva, Rajas, and Tamas), evolving into 25 Tattvas.
2. **Yoga (Founder: Maharshi Patanjali):** The practical psychology and meditative discipline corresponding to Samkhya. Expounded in the *Yoga Sutras* ("Yogash Chitta Vritti Nirodhah"), it outlines the eight-limbed **Ashtanga Yoga**: Yama, Niyama, Asana, Pranayama, Pratyahara, Dharana, Dhyana, and Samadhi.
3. **Nyaya (Founder: Maharshi Akshapada Gautama):** The school of rigorous logic, debate, and epistemology accepting four valid means of knowledge (*Pramanas*): Pratyaksha (perception), Anumana (inference), Upamana (comparison), and Shabda (verbal testimony).
4. **Vaisheshika (Founder: Maharshi Kanada):** Early Indian physics and atomism (*Paramanu-vada*), classifying all knowable reality into Padarthas (Substance, Quality, Action, Generality, Particularity, Inherence, and Non-existence).
5. **Purva Mimamsa (Founder: Maharshi Jaimini):** Focuses on the Karma-Kanda (ritual action and Dharma injunctions) of the Vedas, hermeneutics, and the cosmic law of Apurva (unseen moral potency of actions).
6. **Uttara Mimamsa / Vedanta (Founder: Maharshi Badarayana Vedavyasa):** Centered on the *Prasthana Trayi* (Upanishads, Brahma Sutras, and Bhagavad Gita), investigating Brahman, Atman, and Moksha through major sub-schools:
   - **Advaita Vedanta** (Adi Shankaracharya — Non-dual unity of Atman and Brahman)
   - **Vishishtadvaita** (Sri Ramanujacharya — Qualified Non-dualism)
   - **Dvaita** (Sri Madhvacharya — Dualistic devotional realism)
body.Hindi:
## परिचय: षड्दर्शन क्या है?
भारतीय संस्कृति में दर्शन (Darshana) का अर्थ केवल तर्क नहीं, बल्कि सत्य का प्रत्यक्ष साक्षात्कार है। वेदों को प्रमाण मानने वाले छह आस्तिक दर्शन 'षड्दर्शन' कहलाते हैं:

## छह आस्तिक दर्शन
1. **सांख्य दर्शन (महर्षि कपिल):** पुरुष (चैतन्य) और प्रकृति (सत्त्व, रज, तम गुणमयी) के २५ तत्त्वों का विवेचन।
2. **योग दर्शन (महर्षि पतंजलि):** 'योगश्चित्तवृत्तिनिरोधः'—यम, नियम, आसन, प्राणायाम, प्रत्याहार, धारणा, ध्यान और समाधि का अष्टांग योग मार्ग।
3. **न्याय दर्शन (महर्षि गौतम):** प्रत्यक्ष, अनुमान, उपमान और शब्द—इन चार प्रमाणों तथा तर्कशास्त्र का विज्ञान।
4. **वैशेषिक दर्शन (महर्षि कणाद):** प्राचीन भारतीय परमाणुवाद तथा द्रव्य, गुण, कर्म आदि पदार्थों का विश्लेषण।
5. **पूर्व मीमांसा (महर्षि जैमिनि):** वैदिक धर्म, यज्ञ और कर्मकाण्ड के सिद्धांतों की व्याख्या।
6. **उत्तर मीमांसा / वेदान्त (महर्षि वेदव्यास):** उपनिषद्, ब्रह्मसूत्र और भगवद्गीता (प्रस्थानत्रयी) पर आधारित ब्रह्म और आत्मा का सर्वोच्च ज्ञान—जिसमें अद्वैत (आदि शंकराचार्य), विशिष्टाद्वैत (रामानुजाचार्य) और द्वैत (मध्वाचार्य) प्रमुख धाराएँ हैं।

items.title: The Puranas: Introduction and Guide to the 18 Maha Puranas
items.description: Explore the Puranas, the vast encyclopedias of Sanatan Dharma compiled by Maharshi Vedavyasa. Discover the Pancha Lakshana (five characteristics) and a complete guide to all 18 Maha Puranas.
items.author: Maharshi Krishna Dwaipayana Vedavyasa

body.English:
## Overview: The 18 Maha Puranas (400,000 Shlokas)
Compiled by Maharshi Krishna Dwaipayana Vedavyasa, the **Puranas** ("that which renews ancient eternal truth") translate the subtle revelations of the Vedas into vivid histories, genealogies, cosmology, pilgrimage guides, and practical Dharma. Together, the **18 Maha Puranas** comprise approximately 400,000 Sanskrit verses, complemented by 18 Upapuranas.

## The Five Defining Characteristics (Pancha Lakshana)
Every classical Maha Purana traditionally addresses five cosmic themes:
1. **Sarga:** Primary creation of the universe.
2. **Pratisarga:** Secondary creation and cyclic dissolution (Pralaya).
3. **Vamsha:** Genealogies of Devas, Rishis, and Prajapatis.
4. **Manvantara:** Cosmic epochs ruled by the fourteen Manus.
5. **Vamshanucharita:** Chronicles of the Solar (Suryavamsha) and Lunar (Chandravamsha) dynasties.

## Complete Guide to All 18 Maha Puranas (Classified by Tradition)
- **Six Sattvika / Vaishnava Puranas:**
  1. *Vishnu Purana* (23,000 verses) — Essence of Vaishnava cosmology and Prahlada/Dhruva stories.
  2. *Shrimad Bhagavata Purana* (18,000 verses) — The crown jewel of Bhakti detailing the 10th Canto Krishna Leelas.
  3. *Naradiya Purana* (25,000 verses) — Vrats, devotion, and sacred tirthas.
  4. *Garuda Purana* (19,000 verses) — Dharma, Ayurveda, gems, and the soul's post-mortem journey.
  5. *Padma Purana* (55,000 verses) — Creation, sacred rivers, Gita Mahatmya, and Kartika Vrat.
  6. *Varaha Purana* (24,000 verses) — Teachings of Varaha Avatar to Bhudevi.
- **Six Rajasika / Brahma Puranas:**
  7. *Brahma Purana* (10,000 verses) — Earliest Adi Purana, praising Konark and Puri.
  8. *Brahmanda Purana* (12,000 verses) — Contains the sacred *Lalita Sahasranama* and *Adhyatma Ramayana*.
  9. *Brahma Vaivarta Purana* (18,000 verses) — Glories of Radha-Krishna, Ganesha, and Prakriti.
  10. *Markandeya Purana* (9,000 verses) — Houses the immortal *Devi Mahatmyam (Durga Saptashati)*.
  11. *Bhavishya Purana* (14,500 verses) — Solar worship, Vrats, and prophetic lineages.
  12. *Vamana Purana* (10,000 verses) — Vamana Avatar and sacred shrines.
- **Six Tamasika / Shaiva & Agni Puranas:**
  13. *Shiva Mahapurana* (24,000 verses) — 12 Jyotirlingas, Shiva-Parvati Vivaha, and Rudraksha glory.
  14. *Linga Purana* (11,000 verses) — Symbolism of the Shiva Linga and Pashupata Yoga.
  15. *Skanda Purana* (81,100 verses) — Largest Purana; rich chronicles of Kashi, Puri, Kedar, and Kartikeya.
  16. *Agni Purana* (15,400 verses) — Encyclopedia of temple architecture, grammar, Ayurveda, and ethics.
  17. *Matsya Purana* (14,000 verses) — Manu's Great Flood, Vastu Shastra, and royal duties.
  18. *Kurma Purana* (17,000 verses) — Ishvara Gita and balance of Shiva-Vishnu worship.

## Maharshi Vedavyasa's Two-Line Essence of All 18 Puranas
*"Ashtadasha Puraneshu Vyasasya Vachanadvayam: Paropakarah Punyaya Papaya Parapidanam"* — Helping others is supreme merit (Punya); harming others is sin (Papa).

## परिचय: अष्टादश महापुराण (४,००,००० श्लोक)
महर्षि कृष्णद्वैपायन वेदव्यास द्वारा संकलित १८ महापुराण वेदों के गूढ़ सिद्धांतों को कथाओं, तीर्थ माहात्म्य, सृष्टि-रचना और धर्मनीति के रूप में प्रस्तुत करते हैं। पुराणों के पाँच मुख्य लक्षण (**पंचलक्षण**) हैं: सर्ग, प्रतिसर्ग, वंश, मन्वन्तर और वंशानुचरित।

## सभी १८ महापुराणों की सूची
- **वैष्णव (सात्त्विक) पुराण:** १. विष्णु, २. श्रीमद्भागवत, ३. नारदीय, ४. गरुड़, ५. पद्म, ६. वराह।
- **ब्राह्म (राजसिक) पुराण:** ७. ब्रह्म, ८. ब्रह्माण्ड (ललिता सहस्रनाम), ९. ब्रह्मवैवर्त, १०. मार्कण्डेय (दुर्गा सप्तशती), ११. भविष्य, १२. वामन।
- **शैव (तामसिक) पुराण:** १३. शिव (द्वादश ज्योतिर्लिङ्ग), १४. लिङ्ग, १५. स्कन्द (सबसे विशाल पुराण), १६. अग्नि, १७. मत्स्य, १८. कूर्म।

## १८ पुराणों का सार
महर्षि वेदव्यास ने समस्त अष्टादश पुराणों का सार केवल दो वाक्यों में कहा है—**"परोपकारः पुण्याय पापाय परपीडनम्"** अर्थात दूसरों का उपकार करना ही पुण्य है और दूसरों को पीड़ा पहुँचाना ही पाप है।

items.title: Maa Ambe Ki Sarv Kamna Siddh Prarthana: Full Lyrics + Meaning
items.description: Read the complete Maa Ambe Ki Sarv Kamna Siddh Prarthana from Devi Mahatmyam (Durga Saptashati). This sacred prayer invokes the Divine Mother residing in all beings to fulfill all virtuous wishes.
items.author: Markandeya Purana (Devi Mahatmyam / Aparajita Stuti)

body.English:
## Introduction & Scriptural Source
**Maa Ambe Ki Sarv Kamna Siddh Prarthana** is drawn from the revered **Aparajita Stuti (Tantrokta Devi Suktam)** and **Siddha Samputa Mantras** of the *Devi Mahatmyam (Durga Saptashati)* in the *Markandeya Purana*. Chanted daily or during Navaratri, this sacred hymn bows to the Divine Mother residing inside every living creature as Consciousness, Wisdom, Peace, Compassion, and Energy (Shakti), praying for protection, harmony, and the fulfillment of all righteous aspirations.

## Complete Sacred Verses & English Meaning

**1. Universal Invocation of Auspiciousness:**
*Sarva mangala mangalye Shive sarvartha sadhike |*
*Sharanye Tryambake Gauri Narayani namo'stu te ||*
**Meaning:** Salutations to You, O Narayani, O Auspicious One who bestows all auspiciousness, who fulfills every noble endeavor, the refuge of all, Three-Eyed Mother Gauri!

**2. Salutations to the Indwelling Mother (Devi Suktam):**
*Ya Devi sarvabhuteshu Vishnumayeti shabdita | Namastasyai namastasyai namastasyai namo namah ||*
*Ya Devi sarvabhuteshu Chetanety-abhidhiyate | Namastasyai namastasyai namastasyai namo namah ||*
*Ya Devi sarvabhuteshu Buddhi-rupena samsthita | Namastasyai namastasyai namastasyai namo namah ||*
*Ya Devi sarvabhuteshu Shakti-rupena samsthita | Namastasyai namastasyai namastasyai namo namah ||*
*Ya Devi sarvabhuteshu Shanti-rupena samsthita | Namastasyai namastasyai namastasyai namo namah ||*
*Ya Devi sarvabhuteshu Daya-rupena samsthita | Namastasyai namastasyai namastasyai namo namah ||*
*Ya Devi sarvabhuteshu Matri-rupena samsthita | Namastasyai namastasyai namastasyai namo namah ||*
**Meaning:** Again and again we bow to that Supreme Goddess who abides in all beings as Divine Power, Consciousness, Intellect, Strength, Peace, Compassion, and the Mother of all.

**3. Prayer for Removal of Obstacles & Prosperity:**
*Sarva badha vinirmukto dhana-dhanya sutanvitah |*
*Manushyo matprasadena bhavishyati na samshayah ||*
*Sharanagata dinarta paritrana parayane |*
*Sarvasyarti hare Devi Narayani namo'stu te ||*
**Meaning:** Freed from every obstacle and blessed with abundance, noble progeny, and peace by the grace of the Divine Mother—O Narayani, ever devoted to rescuing the distressed who seek Your refuge, salutations to You!

## Chanting Vidhi & Spiritual Benefits
- **Best Time:** Early morning after bath or during evening Sandhya while lighting a pure ghee diya before Maa Durga.
- **Count:** Chant 1, 3, or 11 times daily—especially auspicious on Tuesdays, Fridays, Ashtami, and Navaratri.
- **Benefits:** Removes fear and inner anxiety, promotes family harmony, sharpens discernment (Buddhi), and invites auspiciousness into the home.

**१. सर्वमंगल वंदना:**

*अर्थ:* सब मंगलों में मंगलमयी, कल्याणकारिणी, सभी मनोरथों को सिद्ध करने वाली, शरणागतवत्सला, तीन नेत्रों वाली हे माँ गौरी नारायणि! आपको मेरा प्रणाम है।

या देवी सर्वभूतेषु बुद्धिरूपेण संस्थिता । नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः ॥

या देवी सर्वभूतेषु दयारूपेण संस्थिता । नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः ॥
या देवी सर्वभूतेषु मातृरूपेण संस्थिता । नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः ॥

**३. सर्वबाधा मुक्ति एवं शरणागति प्रार्थना:**
सर्वबाधाविनिर्मुक्तो धनधान्यसुतान्वितः ।
मनुष्यो मत्प्रसादेन भविष्यति न संशयः ॥
शरणागतदीनार्तपरित्राणपरायणे ।
सर्वस्यार्तिहरे देवि नारायणि नमोऽस्तु ते ॥

## पाठ विधि एवं लाभ
प्रातः या संध्या समय शुद्ध घी का दीपक जलाकर श्रद्धापूर्वक इस प्रार्थना का पाठ करने से समस्त संकट दूर होते हैं, घर में सुख-शांति एवं सद्बुद्धि का वास होता है तथा धर्मसंगत मनोकामनाएँ पूर्ण होती हैं।

items.title: Mahamrityunjaya Mantra: The Great Death-Conquering Chant of Lord Shiva
items.description: Read the complete Mahamrityunjaya Mantra (Tryambakam Mantra) from Rigveda 7.59.12 with Maha-Samputa, word-by-word Sanskrit breakdown, Rishi Markandeya legend, and spiritual healing benefits.
items.author: Maharshi Vasishtha (Rigveda 7.59.12)

body.English:
## Introduction & Scriptural Origin
The **Mahamrityunjaya Mantra** (also called the *Tryambakam Mantra* or *Rudra Mantra*) is revealed to **Maharshi Vasishtha** in **Rigveda 7.59.12** and repeated in the Yajurveda. Revered as the supreme healing and protective chant of Lord Shiva, it conquers fear, promotes deep physical and emotional restoration, and awakens realization of the immortal Self (*Amritatva*).

## Complete Mantra (Sanskrit, Transliteration & Word-by-Word Meaning)
*Om Tryambakam Yajamahe Sugandhim Pushti-Vardhanam |*
*Urvarukam-iva Bandhanan Mrityor Mukshiya Ma'mritat ||*

- **Om:** Primordial cosmic vibration.
- **Tryambakam:** Three-Eyed Lord Shiva (Sun, Moon, and Fire; knower of past, present, and future).
- **Yajamahe:** We worship, adore, and meditate upon.
- **Sugandhim:** Fragrant with spiritual radiance and auspiciousness.
- **Pushti-Vardhanam:** Who nourishes, strengthens, and sustains all life.
- **Urvarukam-iva:** Just like a fully ripened melon/cucumber.
- **Bandhanat:** From its stem/bondage (effortlessly, without pain when ripe).
- **Mrityoh:** From mortality, disease, and fear of death.
- **Mukshiya:** May You liberate us.
- **Ma Amritat:** Never separate us from Immortality (*Moksha*).

## Legend of Sage Markandeya
Destined to live only sixteen years, the young devotee **Markandeya** worshipped a Shiva Linga with intense faith, chanting the Mahamrityunjaya Mantra relentlessly. When Lord Yama arrived at the appointed hour, Lord Shiva Himself emerged as **Kalantaka** (Conqueror of Time), blessing Markandeya with eternal youth (*Chiranjivi*) and immortalizing this mantra as a shield for all seekers.

## Chanting Vidhi & Best Practices
- **Best Time:** Brahma Muhurta (4:30 AM – 6:00 AM) or Mondays and Pradosh evenings.
- **Count:** Chant 11, 27, or **108 times (1 Rudraksha Mala)** slowly with clear pronunciation.
- **Offering:** Offer clean water (*Jalabhisheka*) or Belpatra to Lord Shiva with a prayer for healing and universal peace.
Extended Maha-Samputa (Bija-Enriched) Form
In traditional Anushthana (formal ritual chanting) and Havan, devotees and priests often recite the extended Samputa Mahamrityunjaya Mantra enriched with Vedic Vyahritis and Bija syllables:
ॐ हौं जूं सः ॐ भूर्भुवः स्वः ॐ त्र्यम्बकं यजामहे सुगन्धिं पुष्टिवर्धनम् । उर्वारुकमिव बन्धनान्मृत्योर्मुक्षीय मामृतात् ॐ स्वः भुवः भूः ॐ सः जूं हौं ॐ ॥
Scriptural Origin & The Legend of Rishi Markandeya
The Mahamrityunjaya Mantra is a cornerstone of the Vedic canon. It appears primarily in the Rigveda (7.59.12), attributed to Sage Vasishtha, and recurs across the Yajurveda (Taittiriya Samhita and Vajasaneyi Samhita) as well as the Shiva Purana.
In Puranic tradition, the mantra is closely linked with Rishi Markandeya. Foretold to live only sixteen years, the young sage devoted himself entirely to worshipping Lord Shiva. When Yama, the Lord of Death, arrived at the end of his sixteenth year, Markandeya embraced the Shiva Lingam and chanted this hymn with unwavering devotion. Pleased by his surrender, Lord Shiva manifested as Kalantaka (the Conqueror of Time) and blessed Markandeya with eternal youth (Chiranjeevi).
How to Chant the Mahamrityunjaya Mantra (Sadhana Vidhi)
Consistent, calm pronunciation matters far more than speed. Follow these traditional guidelines for daily practice:
Best Time to Chant: Brahma Muhurta (approximately 4:00 AM to 6:00 AM) is considered most auspicious. You may also chant during Pradosh Kaal (sunset) or on Mondays (Somvar) and Maha Shivaratri.
Posture & Direction: Sit cleanly after bathing on a wool, kusha, or cotton mat facing East or North. Keep your spine upright and eyes gently closed.
Use a 108-Bead Mala: Traditionally, a Rudraksha mala is used for Lord Shiva's mantras. If you are traveling or do not have a physical mala, track your rounds cleanly using our Online 108-Bead Naam Jaap Counter.
Recommended Count: Beginners can start with 11 or 21 chants daily and gradually build up to 1 full Mala (108 chants) per day.
Mental Chanting (Manasika Japa): If you are unwell, elderly, or in a quiet public space, silent mental recitation is traditionally accepted and regarded as deeply contemplative.
Spiritual & Traditional Significance
Inner Calm & Fearlessness: Repeating the rhythmic 32 syllables slows the breath and helps quiet anxiety, especially during periods of uncertainty or grief.
Devotional Focus (Dhyana): Meditating on the metaphor of the ripe fruit detaching naturally cultivates acceptance, detachment (Vairagya), and spiritual maturity.
Auspicious Ritual Use: Families traditionally recite the mantra on birthdays, during Shravan month, on Maha Shivaratri, and while praying for the well-being of loved ones.
Important Note: Mantra chanting is a spiritual and contemplative practice for inner peace and devotion. It is not a medical treatment and should never replace qualified medical advice or care.

**महामृत्युंजय मंत्र** ऋग्वेद (७.५९.१२) में महर्षि वशिष्ठ द्वारा दृष्ट भगवान शिव का सर्वोच्च आरोग्य, आयुष्य और मोक्षदायक महामंत्र है। इसे 'त्र्यम्बक मंत्र' और 'संजीवनी मंत्र' भी कहा जाता है।

## संपूर्ण मंत्र एवं शब्दार्थ
**ॐ त्र्यम्बकं यजामहे सुगन्धिं पुष्टिवर्धनम् ।**
**उर्वारुकमिव बन्धनान्मृत्योर्मुक्षीय माऽमृतात् ॥**

- **त्र्यम्बकम्:** तीन नेत्रों वाले भगवान शिव।
- **यजामहे:** हम आराधना एवं वंदना करते हैं।
- **सुगन्धिं पुष्टिवर्धनम्:** जो सर्वव्यापी सुगंध (सद्गुणों) से युक्त और जीवन-शक्ति के वर्धक हैं।
- **उर्वारुकमिव बन्धनात्:** जिस प्रकार पका हुआ खरबूजा/ककड़ी बिना कष्ट के अपनी बेल से सहज मुक्त हो जाता है।
- **मृत्योर्मुक्षीय माऽमृतात्:** उसी प्रकार वे हमें मृत्यु, रोग और भय के बंधन से मुक्त करें, परंतु अमृतत्व (मोक्ष) से कभी अलग न करें।

## ऋषि मार्कण्डेय की कथा एवं जप विधि
अल्पायु बालक मार्कण्डेय ने पूर्ण श्रद्धा से महामृत्युंजय मंत्र का जप कर भगवान शिव से अमरत्व का वरदान प्राप्त किया। प्रतिदिन प्रातःकाल या सोमवार को रुद्राक्ष की माला पर ११, २१ या **१०८ बार** इस मंत्र का जप करने से मानसिक भय दूर होता है, स्वास्थ्य लाभ होता है और मन को अद्भुत शांति मिलती है।

ॐ त्र्यम्बकं यजामहे सुगन्धिं पुष्टिवर्धनम् ।
उर्वारुकमिव बन्धनान्मृत्योर्मुक्षीय माऽमृतात् ॥ (ऋग्वेदः ७.५९.१२)

ॐ हौं जूं सः ॐ भूर्भुवः स्वः ॐ त्र्यम्बकं यजामहे सुगन्धिं पुष्टिवर्धनम् ।
उर्वारुकमिव बन्धनान्मृत्योर्मुक्षीय माऽमृतात् ॐ स्वः भुवः भूः ॐ सः जूं हौं ॐ ॥ (महासम्पुटित महामृत्युंजय मन्त्रः)

faqs.q: Can anyone chant the Mahamrityunjaya Mantra at home?
faqs.a: Yes, anyone can chant the Mahamrityunjaya Mantra cleanly and respectfully after bathing, preferably in the morning or evening, for peace, healing, and protection.

items.title: The 12 Jyotirlingas of Lord Shiva: Complete Stotram, Locations & Temple Guide
items.description: Complete guide to all 12 sacred Jyotirlinga temples of Lord Shiva across India with the Dwadasa Jyotirlinga Stotram.
items.author: Shiva Mahapurana & Adi Shankaracharya

body.English:
## Overview: The 12 Radiant Columns of Shiva's Infinite Light
According to the *Shiva Mahapurana (Koti Rudra Samhita)*, when Lord Brahma and Lord Vishnu once debated supremacy, Lord Shiva manifested as an infinite pillar of dazzling light (*Jyotirlinga*) piercing the cosmos. The **12 Jyotirlingas** across India mark the twelve supreme earthly manifestations of that eternal flame.

## Complete List of All 12 Jyotirlinga Temples & Locations
1. **Somnath Jyotirlinga (Prabhas Patan, Veraval, Gujarat):** The Adi (first) Jyotirlinga on the Arabian Sea coast, revered for Chandra's penance.
2. **Mallikarjuna Jyotirlinga (Srisailam, Andhra Pradesh):** Situated atop Nallamala Hills along the Krishna River; uniquely both a Jyotirlinga and a Shakti Peetha.
3. **Mahakaleshwar Jyotirlinga (Ujjain, Madhya Pradesh):** The only south-facing (*Dakshinamukhi*) Jyotirlinga, renowned for the sacred dawn *Bhasma Aarti*.
4. **Omkareshwar Jyotirlinga (Khandwa, Madhya Pradesh):** Located on the Om-shaped Mandhata island in the Narmada River.
5. **Kedarnath Jyotirlinga (Rudraprayag, Uttarakhand):** Set at 3,583 m in the Garhwal Himalayas near the Mandakini River; central to the Pandava legend.
6. **Bhimashankar Jyotirlinga (Pune, Maharashtra):** Nestled in the Sahyadri hills at the origin of the Bhima River.
7. **Kashi Vishwanath Jyotirlinga (Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh):** On the western bank of the Ganga in the eternal city of Moksha.
8. **Trimbakeshwar Jyotirlinga (Nashik, Maharashtra):** Near the source of the Godavari River; uniquely features three faces representing Brahma, Vishnu, and Mahesh.
9. **Vaidyanath / Baidyanath Jyotirlinga (Deoghar, Jharkhand):** Revered as Baba Baidyanath Dham, the supreme healer (*Vaidya*).
10. **Nageshwar Jyotirlinga (Dwarka, Gujarat):** Protector from all poisons and spiritual obstacles.
11. **Ramanathaswamy Jyotirlinga (Rameswaram, Tamil Nadu):** Consecrated by Lord Sri Rama and Devi Sita before crossing to Lanka; home to the world's longest temple corridor.
12. **Grishneshwar / Ghushmeshwar Jyotirlinga (Ellora, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Maharashtra):** The twelfth Jyotirlinga near Ellora Caves, celebrating devotee Ghushma's unwavering faith.

## Complete Dwadasa Jyotirlinga Stotram (Adi Shankaracharya)
*Saurashtre Somanatham cha Shrishaile Mallikarjunam |*
*Ujjayinyam Mahakalam Omkaram-amaleshwaram || 1 ||*
*Paralyam Vaidyanatham cha Dakinyam Bhimashankaram |*
*Setubandhe tu Ramesham Nagesham Darukavane || 2 ||*
*Varanasyam tu Vishvesham Tryambakam Gautami-tate |*
*Himalaye tu Kedaram Ghushmesham cha Shivalaye || 3 ||*
*Etani Jyotirlingani Sayam Pratah Pathennarah |*
*Sapta-janma-kritam Papam Smaranena Vinashyati || 4 ||*
*(Whoever recites these twelve sacred Jyotirlinga names morning and evening dissolves accumulated karmic burdens and attains the grace of Lord Shiva.)*
body.Hindi:
## परिचय: भगवान शिव के द्वादश (१२) ज्योतिर्लिङ्ग
शिव महापुराण के कोटिरुद्र संहिता के अनुसार, जहाँ-जहाँ भगवान शिव स्वयं अनंत ज्योति-स्तम्भ के रूप में प्रकट हुए, वे बारह पावन स्थल **द्वादश ज्योतिर्लिङ्ग** कहलाते हैं।

## सभी १२ ज्योतिर्लिङ्ग एवं उनके स्थान
१. **श्री सोमनाथ** (प्रभास पाटन, गुजरात), २. **श्री मल्लिकार्जुन** (श्रीशैलम, आंध्र प्रदेश), ३. **श्री महाकालेश्वर** (उज्जैन, मध्य प्रदेश—दक्षिणामुखी एवं भस्म आरती हेतु प्रसिद्ध), ४. **श्री ॐकारेश्वर** (खण्डवा, नर्मदा तट, मध्य प्रदेश), ५. **श्री केदारनाथ** (रुद्रप्रयाग, हिमालय, उत्तराखंड), ६. **श्री भीमाशंकर** (पुणे, महाराष्ट्र), ७. **श्री काशी विश्वनाथ** (वाराणसी, उत्तर प्रदेश), ८. **श्री त्र्यम्बकेश्वर** (नासिक, गोदावरी उद्गम, महाराष्ट्र), ९. **श्री वैद्यनाथ / बाबा बैद्यनाथ** (देवघर, झारखंड), १०. **श्री नागेश्वर** (द्वारका, गुजरात), ११. **श्री रामेश्वरम** (तमिलनाडु—श्रीराम द्वारा स्थापित), और १२. **श्री घृष्णेश्वर** (एलोरा, महाराष्ट्र)।

## द्वादश ज्योतिर्लिङ्ग स्तोत्रम्
सौराष्ट्रे सोमनाथं च श्रीशैले मल्लिकार्जुनम् । उज्जयिन्यां महाकालमोङ्कारममलेश्वरम् ॥ १ ॥
परल्यां वैद्यनाथं च डाकिन्यां भीमशङ्करम् । सेतुबन्धे तु रामेशं नागेशं दारुकावने ॥ २ ॥
वाराणस्यां तु विश्वेशं त्र्यम्बकं गौतमीतटे । हिमालये तु केदारं घुश्मेशं च शिवालये ॥ ३ ॥
एतानि ज्योतिर्लिङ्गानि सायं प्रातः पठेन्नरः । सप्तजन्मकृतं पापं स्मरणेन विनश्यति ॥ ४ ॥

items.title: Shiva Tandava Stotram: Complete 17 Verses by Ravana with Hindi & English Meaning
items.description: Read the complete Shiva Tandava Stotram (Jatatavigalajjala Pravahapavitasthale) composed by Ravana.
items.author: Ravana (Lankeshwara)

body.English:
## Introduction & Legend of Composition
The **Shiva Tandava Stotram** is one of the most electrifying Sanskrit hymns ever composed, set in the galloping *Panchachamara* meter (*Laghu-Guru* alternating rhythm). According to Puranic tradition, **Ravana** (King of Lanka and an accomplished Vedic scholar) once attempted to uproot Mount Kailash. Lord Shiva gently pressed the mountain down with His big toe, pinning Ravana's arms beneath Kailash. Realizing his arrogance, Ravana sang this spontaneous masterpiece praising the cosmic dance (*Tandava*) of Lord Shiva—who was deeply pleased, freed him, and granted him the invincible *Chandrahasa* sword.

## Core Stanzas (Transliteration & Meaning)

**Verse 1:**
*Jatatavigalajjala-pravahapavitasthale Gale'valambya lambitam bhujangatungamalikam |*
*Damaddamaddamaddamanninaadavad-damarvayam Chakara chandatandavam tanotu nah Shivah shivam ||*
*(With his neck consecrated by the sacred flow of Ganga cascading from the forest of his matted locks, wearing a lofty serpent garland as his damaru resonates 'damad-damad,' may Lord Shiva performing His mighty Tandava shower auspiciousness upon us.)*

**Verse 2:**
*Jatakatahasambhrama-bhramannilimpanirjhari Vilolavichivallari-virajamanamurdhani |*
*Dhagaddhagaddhagajjvala-llalatapattapavake Kishorachandrashekhare ratih pratikshanam mama ||*
*(May my devotion abide every moment in the Lord whose head shines with the swirling waves of celestial Ganga, whose forehead blazes with the fire of the Third Eye, and who wears the crescent moon as His crown.)*

**Verse 3:**
*Dharadharendranandini-vilasabandhubandhura Sphuraddigantasantati-pramodamanamanase |*
*Kripakatakshadharoni-niruddhadurdharapadi Kvachiddigambare mano vinodametu vastuni ||*
*(May my mind find eternal joy in the sky-clad Lord whose compassionate glance removes the gravest calamities and whose heart delights in Mother Parvati, daughter of the Himalayas.)*

**Verse 10 (Prayer for Equanimity):**
*Kadā nilimpanirjhari-nikunjakotare vasan Vimuktadurmatih sada shirahsthamanjalim vahan |*
*Vilolalalalochana-lalamabhalalagnakah Shiveti mantramuchcharan kada sukhi bhavamyaham ||*
*(When shall I dwell peacefully by the sacred banks of the Ganga, freed from impure thoughts, joining my palms above my head and joyfully chanting 'Shiva, Shiva' forever?)*

**Verse 15 (Phalashruti — Fruit of Recitation):**
*Pujavasanasamaye dashavaktragitam Yah shambhupujanaparam pathati pradoshe |*
*Tasya sthiram rathagajendraturangayuktam Lakshmim sadaiva sumukhim pradadati Shambhuh ||*
*(Whoever recites this hymn composed by the ten-headed Ravana with devotion at the close of Shiva Puja or during Pradosh twilight is blessed by Lord Shambhu with steadfast prosperity, fearlessness, and unwavering devotion.)*
body.Hindi:
## परिचय एवं रचना की कथा
**शिव ताण्डव स्तोत्रम्** पञ्चचामर छंद में रचित भगवान शिव का सर्वाधिक ओजस्वी स्तोत्र है। जब लंकापति रावण ने अहंकारवश कैलाश पर्वत उठाने का प्रयास किया और शिव जी के अंगूठे के भार से दब गया, तब उसने क्षमा याचना करते हुए इस दिव्य स्तोत्र की रचना की। प्रसन्न होकर महादेव ने उसे मुक्त कर 'चंद्रहास' खड्ग प्रदान किया।

## प्रमुख श्लोक एवं अर्थ
१. **जटाटवीगलज्जलप्रवाहपावितस्थले गलेऽवलम्ब्य लम्बितां भुजङ्गतुङ्गमालिकाम् । डमड्डमड्डमड्डमन्निनादवड्डमर्वयं चकार चण्डताण्डवं तनोतु नः शिवः शिवम् ॥**
*अर्थ:* जिनकी सघन जटाओं से प्रवाहित गंगाजल से कंठ पवित्र है, गले में सर्पों की माला सुशोभित है और डमरू के 'डम-डम' नाद के साथ जो प्रचंड ताण्डव करते हैं, वे भगवान शिव हमारा कल्याण करें।

२. **जटाकटाहसम्भ्रमभ्रमन्निलिम्पनिर्झरी विलोलवीचिवल्लरीविराजमानमूर्धनि । धगद्धगद्धगज्ज्वलल्ललाटपट्टपावके किशोरचन्द्रशेखरे रतिः प्रतिक्षणं मम ॥**
*अर्थ:* जिनके मस्तक पर बालचंद्र और ललाट पर प्रज्वलित अग्नि सुशोभित है, उन महादेव में मेरी भक्ति प्रतिक्षण बढ़ती रहे।

३. **कदा निलिम्पनिर्झरी निकुञ्जकोटरे वसन् विमुक्तदुर्मतिः सदा शिरःस्थमञ्जलिं वहन् । विलोललोललोचनो ललामभाललग्नकः शिवेति मन्त्रमुच्चरन् कदा सुखी भवाम्यहम् ॥**
*अर्थ:* कब मैं गंगा के पावन तट पर निवास कर, समस्त कुविचारों से मुक्त हो, मस्तक पर अंजलि बाँधे निरंतर 'शिव-शिव' मंत्र का उच्चारण करते हुए परम सुखी होऊँगा?

## पाठ विधि एवं लाभ
प्रदोष काल, सोमवार या महाशिवरात्रि पर शिव ताण्डव स्तोत्र का पाठ करने से आत्मविश्वास, वाणी का ओज, एकाग्रता और भगवान शिव की असीम कृपा प्राप्त होती है।
body.Sanskrit:
जटाटवीगलज्जलप्रवाहपावितस्थले गलेऽवलम्ब्य लम्बितां भुजङ्गतुङ्गमालिकाम् ।
डमड्डमड्डमड्डमन्निनादवड्डमर्वयं चकार चण्डताण्डवं तनोतु नः शिवः शिवम् ॥ १ ॥

जटाकटाहसम्भ्रमभ्रमन्निलिम्पनिर्झरी विलोलवीचिवल्लरीविराजमानमूर्धनि ।
धगद्धगद्धगज्ज्वलल्ललाटपट्टपावके किशोरचन्द्रशेखरे रतिः प्रतिक्षणं मम ॥ २ ॥

पूजावसानसमये दशवक्त्रगीतं यः शम्भुपूजनपरं पठति प्रदोषे ।
तस्य स्थिरां रथगजेन्द्रतुरङ्गयुक्तां लक्ष्मीं सदैव सुमुखीं प्रददाति शम्भुः ॥ १५ ॥

faqs.q: When is the best time to recite Shiva Tandava Stotram?
faqs.a: According to the Phalashruti verse, reciting it during Pradosh twilight (around sunset) or right after Shiva Puja on Mondays and Maha Shivaratri is most auspicious.

faqs.q: Can women and beginners chant Shiva Tandava Stotram?
faqs.a: Yes, anyone with sincere devotion and clean pronunciation can read, chant, or listen to Shiva Tandava Stotram.

items.title: Shri Durga Chalisa (Namo Namo Durge Sukh Karani): Complete 40 Verses with Meaning
items.description: Read and chant the complete 40 verses of Shri Durga Chalisa in Hindi and English.
items.author: Shakta Devotional Tradition

body.English:
## Introduction & Spiritual Significance
**Shri Durga Chalisa** is a revered 40-verse devotional hymn dedicated to **Goddess Durga (Maa Adi Shakti)** celebrating Her manifestations as Shailaputri, Brahmacharini, Chandraghanta, Kushmanda, Skandamata, Katyayani, Kalaratri, Mahagauri, and Siddhidatri, and Her triumph over Mahishasura, Shumbha, and Nishumbha.

## Complete 40 Verses (English Transliteration)
1. Namo Namo Durge sukh karani | Namo Namo Ambe dukh harani ||
2. Nirakar hai jyoti tumhari | Tihun lok phaili ujiyari ||
3. Shashi lalat mukh maha vishala | Netra lal bhrikuti vikarala ||
4. Roop matu ko adhik suhave | Darash karat jan ati sukh pave ||
5. Tum sansar shakti lay kina | Palan hetu anna dhan dina ||
6. Annapurna hui jag pala | Tum hi adi Sundari Bala ||
7. Pralayakal sab nashan hari | Tum Gauri Shiv Shankar pyari ||
8. Shiv yogi tumhare gun gavein | Brahma Vishnu tumhein nit dhyavein ||
9. Roop Saraswati ko tum dhara | De subuddhi rishi munin ubara ||
10. Dharyo roop Narsimha ko Amba | Pragat bhai phadkar khamba ||
11. Raksha kari Prahlad bachayo | Hiranyakush ko swarga pathayo ||
12. Lakshmi roop dharo jag mahin | Shri Narayan ang samahin ||
13. Kshir sindhu mein karat vilasa | Daya sindhu dijai man asa ||
14. Hinglaj mein tumhin Bhavani | Mahima amit na jat bakhani ||
15. Matangi aru Dhumavati mata | Bhuvaneshwari bagala sukhdata ||
16. Shri Bhairav Tara jag tarini | Chhinna Bhal bhav dukh nivarini ||
17. Kehari vahan soh Bhavani | Langur vir chalat agavani ||
18. Kar mein khappar khadag virajai | Jako dekh kal dar bhajai ||
19. Sohe astra aur trishula | Jate uthat shatru hiy shula ||
20. Nagarkot mein tumhin virajat | Tihun lok mein danka bajat ||
21. Shumbh Nishumbh danav tum mare | Raktabij shankhan sanhare ||
22. Mahishasur nrip ati abhimani | Jehi agh bhar mahi akulani ||
23. Roop karal Kali ka dhara | Sen sahit tum tihin sanhara ||
24. Pari gadha santan par jab jab | Bhayi sahay matu tum tab tab ||
25. Amarpuri aru basav loka | Tab mahima sab rahein ashoka ||
26. Jwala mein hai jyoti tumhari | Tumhein sada pujein nar-nari ||
27. Prem bhakti se jo yash gavein | Dukh daridra nikat nahin avein ||
28. Dhyavein tumhein jo nar man layi | Janma maran tako chhuti jayi ||
29. Jogi sur muni kahat pukari | Yog na ho bin shakti tumhari ||
30. Shankar Acharaj tap kino | Kam aru krodh jeet sab lino ||
31. Nishidin dhyan dharo Shankar ko | Kahu kal nahin sumiro tumko ||
32. Shakti roop ka maram na payo | Shakti gayi tab man pachhatayo ||
33. Sharanagat hui kirti bakhani | Jai Jai Jai Jagdambe Bhavani ||
34. Bhayi prasanna Adi Jagdamba | Dayi shakti nahin kin vilamba ||
35. Moko matu kashta ati ghero | Tum bin kaun harai dukh mero ||
36. Asha trishna nipat satavein | Moh madadik sab binashavein ||
37. Shatru nash kijai Maharani | Sumiron ikchit tumhein Bhavani ||
38. Karo kripa he matu dayala | Riddhi-siddhi dai karahu nihala ||
39. Jab lagi jiyun daya phal paun | Tumharo yash main sada sunaun ||
40. Durga Chalisa jo koi gave | Sab sukh bhog param pad pave ||

## Closing Doha
*Devidas sharan nij jani | Karahu kripa Jagdambe Bhavani ||*

## Chanting Vidhi & Benefits
Reciting Shri Durga Chalisa daily after lighting a ghee lamp—especially on Fridays, Ashtami, and during Navaratri—dissolves fear, strengthens willpower, and brings peace and abundance to the household.

## परिचय
**श्री दुर्गा चालीसा** माँ आदिशक्ति जगदम्बा की ४० पंक्तियों की परम पावन स्तुति है, जिसका नियमित पाठ भय, संकट और दरिद्रता का नाश कर सुख-समृद्धि एवं आत्मबल प्रदान करता है।

## संपूर्ण श्री दुर्गा चालीसा (४० चौपाइयाँ)
१. नमो नमो दुर्गे सुख करनी । नमो नमो अम्बे दुःख हरनी ॥
२. निराकार है ज्योति तुम्हारी । तिहूँ लोक फैली उजियारी ॥
३. शशि ललाट मुख महाविशाला । नेत्र लाल भृकुटि विकराला ॥
४. रूप मातु को अधिक सुहावे । दरश करत जन अति सुख पावे ॥
५. तुम संसार शक्ति लय कीना । पालन हेतु अन्न धन दीना ॥
६. अन्नपूर्णा हुई जग पाला । तुम ही आदि सुन्दरी बाला ॥
७. प्रलयकाल सब नाशन हारी । तुम गौरी शिवशंकर प्यारी ॥
८. शिव योगी तुम्हरे गुण गावें । ब्रह्मा विष्णु तुम्हें नित ध्यावें ॥
९. रूप सरस्वती को तुम धारा । दे सुबुद्धि ऋषि मुनिन उबारा ॥
१०. धरयो रूप नरसिंह को अम्बा । परगट भई फाड़कर खम्बा ॥
११. रक्षा करि प्रह्लाद बचायो । हिरण्याक्ष को स्वर्ग पठायो ॥
१२. लक्ष्मी रूप धरो जग माहीं । श्री नारायण अंग समाहीं ॥
१३. क्षीरसिन्धु में करत विलासा । दयासिन्धु दीजै मन आसा ॥
१४. हिंगलाज में तुम्हीं भवानी । महिमा अमित न जात बखानी ॥
१५. मातंगी अरु धूमावति माता । भुवनेश्वरी बगला सुखदाता ॥
१६. श्री भैरव तारा जग तारिणी । छिन्न भाल भव दुःख निवारिणी ॥
१७. केहरि वाहन सोह भवानी । लांगुर वीर चलत अगवानी ॥
१८. कर में खप्पर खड्ग विराजै । जाको देख काल डर भाजै ॥
१९. सोहै अस्त्र और त्रिशूला । जाते उठत शत्रु हिय शूला ॥
२०. नगरकोट में तुम्हीं विराजत । तिहुँ लोक में डंका बाजत ॥
२१. शुम्भ निशुम्भ दानव तुम मारे । रक्तबीज शंखन संहारे ॥
२२. महिषासुर नृप अति अभिमानी । जेहि अघ भार मही अकुलानी ॥
२३. रूप कराल काली का धारा । सेन सहित तुम तिहि संहारा ॥
२४. परी गाढ़ सन्तन पर जब जब । भई सहाय मातु तुम तब तब ॥
२५. अमरपुरी अरु बासव लोका । तब महिमा सब रहें अशोका ॥
२६. ज्वाला में है ज्योति तुम्हारी । तुम्हें सदा पूजें नर-नारी ॥
२७. प्रेम भक्ति से जो यश गावें । दुःख दारिद्र निकट नहिं आवें ॥
२८. ध्यावे तुम्हें जो नर मन लाई । जन्म-मरण ताकौ छुटि जाई ॥
२९. जोगी सुर मुनि कहत पुकारी । योग न हो बिन शक्ति तुम्हारी ॥
३०. शंकर आचारज तप कीनो । काम अरु क्रोध जीति सब लीनो ॥
३१. निशिदिन ध्यान धरो शंकर को । काहु काल नहिं सुमिरो तुमको ॥
३२. शक्ति रूप का मरम न पायो । शक्ति गई तब मन पछतायो ॥
३३. शरणागत हुई कीर्ति बखानी । जय जय जय जगदम्बे भवानी ॥
३४. भई प्रसन्न आदि जगदम्बा । दई शक्ति नहिं कीन विलम्बा ॥
३५. मोको मातु कष्ट अति घेरो । तुम बिन कौन हरै दुःख मेरो ॥
३६. आशा तृष्णा निपट सतावें । मोह मदादिक सब बिनशावें ॥
३७. शत्रु नाश कीजै महारानी । सुमिरौं इकचित तुम्हें भवानी ॥
३८. करो कृपा हे मातु दयाला । ऋद्धि-सिद्धि दै करहु निहाला ॥
३९. जब लगि जियऊँ दया फल पाऊँ । तुम्हरो यश मैं सदा सुनाऊँ ॥
४०. दुर्गा चालीसा जो कोई गावै । सब सुख भोग परमपद पावै ॥

## दोहा
देवीदास शरण निज जानी । करहु कृपा जगदम्बे भवानी ॥

body.English:
## Introduction & Spiritual Glory
Composed by devotee **Ayodhya Das**, the **Shri Shiv Chalisa** is a beloved 40-verse Awadhi-Hindi hymn honoring **Lord Shiva (Bholenath)**—the easily pleased, compassionate Lord of Kailash, Mount Meru, and all yogis.

## Opening Doha
*Jai Ganesh Girija Suvan, Mangal Mul Sujan |*
*Kahat Ayodhya Das Tum, Dehu Abhay Varadan ||*

## Complete 40 Verses (English Transliteration)
1. Jai Girija Pati Din Dayala | Sada karat santan pratipala ||
2. Bhal chandrama sohat nike | Kanan kundal nagaphani ke ||
3. Ang gaur shir Gang bahaye | Mundamal tan chhar lagaye ||
4. Vastra khal baghambar sohe | Chhavi ko dekhi nag muni mohe ||
5. Maina Matu ki have dulari | Bam ang sohat chhavi nyari ||
6. Kar mein trishul sohat chhavi bhari | Karat sada shatrun kshayakari ||
7. Nandi Ganesh sohain tahan kaise | Sagar madhya kamal hain jaise ||
8. Kartik Shyam aur ganaraoo | Ya chhavi ko kahi jat na kaoo ||
9. Devan jabahin jaya pukara | Tab hi dukh Prabhu aap nivara ||
10. Kiya upadrav Tarak bhari | Devan sab mili tumhin juhari ||
11. Turat Shadanana aap pathayau | Lavanimesh mahan mari girayau ||
12. Aap Jalandhar asur sanhara | Suyash tumhara vidit sansara ||
13. Tripurasur san yuddha machai | Sabhin kripa kar lina bachai ||
14. Kiya tapahin Bhagirath bhari | Purab pratigya tasu purari ||
15. Danin mahan tum sam kou nahin | Sevak stuti karat sadahin ||
16. Ved nam mahima tav gai | Akath anadi bhed nahin pai ||
17. Pragati udadhi manthan mein jwala | Jarat surasur bhaye bihala ||
18. Kinha daya tahan kari sahai | Nilakantha tab nam kahai ||
19. Pujan Ramachandra jab kinha | Jeet ke Lanka Vibhishan dinha ||
20. Sahas kamal mein ho rahe dhari | Kinha pariksha tabahin Purari ||
21. Ek kamal Prabhu rakheu goi | Kamal nayan pujan chahan soi ||
22. Kathin bhakti dekhi Prabhu Shankar | Bhaye prasanna diye ichchhit var ||
23. Jai Jai Jai Anant Avinashi | Karat kripa sab ke ghatavasi ||
24. Dushta sakal nit mohi satavein | Bhramat rahein mohi chain na avein ||
25. Trahi trahi main nath pukaro | Yehi avasar mohi aan ubaro ||
26. Lai trishul shatrun ko maro | Sankat te mohi aan ubaro ||
27. Matu-pita bhrata sab hoi | Sankat mein puchhat nahin koi ||
28. Swami ek hai aas tumhari | Aay harahu mam sankat bhari ||
29. Dhan nirdhan ko det sadahin | Jo koi janche so phal pahin ||
30. Astuti kehi vidhi karain tumhari | Kshamahu nath ab chuk hamari ||
31. Shankar ho sankat ke nashan | Mangal karan vighna vinashan ||
32. Yogi yati muni dhyan lagavein | Sharad Narad shish navavein ||
33. Namo Namo Jai Namah Shivaya | Sur Brahmadik par na paya ||
34. Jo yah path kare man lai | Ta par hot hain Shambhu sahai ||
35. Riniyan jo koi ho adhikari | Path kare so pavan hari ||
36. Putra hona kar ichchha koi | Nishchay Shiv prasad tehi hoi ||
37. Pandit trayodashi ko lave | Dhyan purvak hom karave ||
38. Trayodashi vrat kare hamesha | Tan nahin take rahe kalesha ||
39. Dhup dip naivedya chadhavai | Shankar sammukh path sunavai ||
40. Janma janma ke pap nasavai | Anta dham Shivpur mein pavai ||

## Closing Doha
*Nitya nem uthi pratahin, path karo chalis | Tum meri manokamana, purna karo Jagdish ||*
body.Hindi:
## परिचय
अयोध्या दास द्वारा रचित **श्री शिव चालीसा** भगवान भोलेनाथ की ४० चौपाइयों की सरल और अत्यंत प्रभावशाली स्तुति है।

## दोहा
जय गणेश गिरिजा सुवन, मंगल मूल सुजान । कहत अयोध्यादास तुम, देहु अभय वरदान ॥

## संपूर्ण श्री शिव चालीसा (४० चौपाइयाँ)
१. जय गिरिजा पति दीन दयाला । सदा करत सन्तन प्रतिपाला ॥
२. भाल चन्द्रमा सोहत नीके । कानन कुण्डल नागफनी के ॥
३. अंग गौर शिर गंग बहाये । मुण्डमाल तन क्षार लगाये ॥
४. वस्त्र खाल बाघम्बर सोहे । छवि को देखि नाग मन मोहे ॥
५. मैना मातु की हवे दुलारी । बाम अंग सोहत छवि न्यारी ॥
६. कर त्रिशूल सोहत छवि भारी । करत सदा शत्रुन क्षयकारी ॥
७. नन्दि गणेश सोहै तहँ कैसे । सागर मध्य कमल हैं जैसे ॥
८. कार्तिक श्याम और गणराऊ । या छवि को कहि जात न काऊ ॥
९. देवन जबहीं जाय पुकारा । तब ही दुख प्रभु आप निवारा ॥
१०. किया उपद्रव तारक भारी । देवन सब मिलि तुमहिं जुहारी ॥
११. तुरत षडानन आप पठायउ । लवनिमेष महँ मारि गिरायउ ॥
१२. आप जलंधर असुर संहारा । सुयश तुम्हार विदित संसारा ॥
१३. त्रिपुरासुर सन युद्ध मचाई । सबहिं कृपा कर लीन बचाई ॥
१४. किया तपहिं भागीरथ भारी । पुरब प्रतिज्ञा तासु पुरारी ॥
१५. दानिन महँ तुम सम कोउ नाहीं । सेवक स्तुति करत सदाहीं ॥
१६. वेद नाम महिमा तव गाई । अकथ अनादि भेद नहिं पाई ॥
१७. प्रगटी उदधि मंथन में ज्वाला । जरत सुरासुर भए विहाला ॥
१८. कीन्ह दया तहँ करी सहाई । नीलकण्ठ तब नाम कहाई ॥
१९. पूजन रामचन्द्र जब कीन्हा । जीत के लंक विभीषण दीन्हा ॥
२०. सहस कमल में हो रहे धारी । कीन्ह परीक्षा तबहिं पुरारी ॥
२१. एक कमल प्रभु राखेउ जोई । कमल नयन पूजन चहं सोई ॥
२२. कठिन भक्ति देखी प्रभु शंकर । भए प्रसन्न दिए इच्छित वर ॥
२३. जय जय जय अनन्त अविनाशी । करत कृपा सब के घटवासी ॥
२४. दुष्ट सकल नित मोहि सतावै । भ्रमत रहौं मोहि चैन न आवै ॥
२५. त्राहि त्राहि मैं नाथ पुकारो । यहि अवसर मोहि आन उबारो ॥
२६. लै त्रिशूल शत्रुन को मारो । संकट से मोहि आन उबारो ॥
२७. मात-पिता भ्राता सब होई । संकट में पूछत नहिं कोई ॥
२८. स्वामी एक है आस तुम्हारी । आय हरहु मम संकट भारी ॥
२९. धन निर्धन को देत सदा हीं । जो कोई जांचे सो फल पाहीं ॥
३०. अस्तुति केहि विधि करैं तुम्हारी । क्षमहु नाथ अब चूक हमारी ॥
३१. शंकर हो संकट के नाशन । मंगल कारण विघ्न विनाशन ॥
३२. योगी यति मुनि ध्यान लगावैं । शारद नारद शीश नवावैं ॥
३३. नमो नमो जय नमः शिवाय । सुर ब्रह्मादिक पार न पाय ॥
३४. जो यह पाठ करे मन लाई । ता पर होत हैं शम्भु सहाई ॥
३५. ॠनियाँ जो कोई हो अधिकारी । पाठ करे सो पावन हारी ॥
३६. पुत्र होन कर इच्छा जोई । निश्चय शिव प्रसाद तेहि होई ॥
३७. पण्डित त्रयोदशी को लावे । ध्यान पूर्वक होम करावे ॥
३८. त्रयोदशी व्रत करै हमेशा । तन नहिं ताके रहै कलेशा ॥
३९. धूप दीप नैवेद्य चढ़ावे । शंकर सम्मुख पाठ सुनावे ॥
४०. जन्म जन्म के पाप नसावे । अन्त धाम शिवपुर में पावे ॥

## दोहा
नित्य नेम उठि प्रातःहीं, पाठ करो चालीस । तुम मेरी मनोकामना, पूर्ण करो जगदीश ॥
body.Sanskrit: कर्पूरगौरं करुणावतारं संसारसारं भुजगेन्द्रहारम् । सदा वसन्तं हृदयारविन्दे भवं भवानीसहितं नमामि ॥

faqs.q: Which day is best to chant Shri Shiv Chalisa?
faqs.a: Mondays (Somvara), Pradosh (Trayodashi), and Maha Shivaratri are especially sacred for chanting Shri Shiv Chalisa after offering water to Lord Shiva.

faqs.q: What is the Trayodashi Vrat mentioned in Shiv Chalisa?
faqs.a: Verses 37–38 refer to Pradosh Vrat observed on the 13th lunar day (Trayodashi) of every fortnight, dedicated to Lord Shiva.
